Author: wallawallaslytherin
Name: Frame Mouseover
Description: Use any eligible friendly-targeted spell or ability on the unit under your cursor in the native party, alliance, or other unit frames. Automatically reads action targeting rules; no spell lists or macros. Keeps your selected target and native action queue.
Punchline: Automatic friendly mouseover casting with no spell lists.
Changelog: Initial release: automatic friendly mouseover casting on native unit frames, with normal targeting and action queue behavior preserved.
